source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
With **HERETIC ASTARTES** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), you can take these units, giving them **HERETIC ASTARTES** in place of their own Faction keywords:

- **KHORNE BERZERKERS**, normally **WORLD EATERS**.
- **RUBRIC MARINES**, normally **THOUSAND SONS**.
- **PLAGUE MARINES**, normally **DEATH GUARD**.
- **NOISE MARINES**, normally **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN**.

Their combined points cannot exceed the allowance for the [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- **Incursion**: 250 points.
- **Strike Force**: 500 points.
- **Onslaught**: 750 points.
